items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I only worked with him once.

ctx.x: I think so, yeah. He at one point was a very good reader. I mean he was working in Woody’s band. And like all good readers, I mean there were some people and always have been people in bands that couldn’t read very well but could hear it and see it, and that would be enough. You’d put it up there to remind you what to play and their musicianship would rule the day and they could keep the gig because — Stan used to read something once and never look at it again, Stan Getz. They used to say that he had a mind like…
Can you recall one of your worst dates ever?
